loginTagline.en: Set sail on the sea of clouds, and everything lands.

zh.night: 夜深了，剩下的交给星光

en.morning: The early sail catches the wind.
en.noon: A short nap at anchor recharges the sails.
en.afternoon: Afternoon wind rises — sails at full stretch.
en.evening: Dusk settles in — the sails come home full.
en.night: Leave the rest to the stars. Rest well.
